props.eyebrow: Wedding and event music at a Broomfield resort hotel
props.title: Omni Interlocken Hotel
props.lede: Omni Interlocken sits on a 27-hole golf course between Denver and Boulder, with views of the Rockies and about 40,000 sq ft of indoor and outdoor event space.

headingText.html: It’s a favorite for company meetings from both cities, and for weddings with the ceremony on the lawn and the reception in the ballroom.

props.title: Live music in each Omni Interlocken event space
props.lede: Here’s the act we’d pick for each space. Press play to hear it over the photo.

spaces.name: Ceremony lawn
spaces.facts: The lawn holds ceremonies of up to 220 guests seated, looking out over the golf course.
spaces.why: A solo violin to a full string quartet, from the ceremony through dinner.

spaces.name: Outdoor Pavilion
spaces.facts: The Outdoor Pavilion is covered, about 4,750 sq ft, for banquets of up to 320 and receptions of up to 475, with golf course views, a waterfall and a fire pit. It’s open from late May to early October.
spaces.why: Flamenco and rumba on Spanish guitar, for a cocktail hour or a dinner.
spaces.alt: The pavilion set for a wedding dinner under a wood-beamed ceiling and iron chandeliers.

spaces.name: Interlocken Ballroom
spaces.facts: The Interlocken Ballroom is about 9,100 sq ft with 16-foot ceilings, for receptions of up to about 950 and weddings of up to 500 seated with a dance floor. It divides into four salons, and its pre-function space looks out over the golf course.
spaces.why: A six-piece band playing 90s and 2000s R&B and hip-hop, for when you want everyone dancing.
spaces.alt: A round table set for a wedding dinner with candles and flowers in the Interlocken Ballroom.

spaces.name: Centennial Ballroom
spaces.facts: The Centennial Ballroom is about 4,100 sq ft, for receptions of up to about 420 and weddings of up to 170 with a dance floor. It splits into two equal halves.
spaces.why: He can start as a duo and grow to a full band over the evening.
spaces.alt: Wooden chairs and pampas grass set for a ceremony before a curtain of lights in the Centennial Ballroom.

spaces.name: Ponderosa
spaces.facts: Ponderosa is about 1,600 sq ft, with French doors to the lobby atrium, for dinners of up to 70 with a dance floor.
spaces.why: Upright bass and guitar, at a volume nobody has to raise their voice over.

rows.text: Our acts bring their own sound system, sized to the space. Pinnacle Live is the hotel’s recommended AV company for anything more.
The hotel doesn’t provide a day-of wedding coordinator, so we plan load-in and setup with your planner and the hotel’s events team.
The hotel caters every event in-house.
The Outdoor Pavilion is open from late May to early October, so a winter event moves inside to the ballrooms.
Self-parking at the hotel is free.

props.html: Questions to ask the Omni Interlocken events team

items.html: Which spaces have an end time for amplified music, and when is it?
Does Pinnacle Live need to connect or run the band’s sound, and is there a fee for that?
Where do vendors load in, and when can the band set up?
Is there power near where the band will play?
What wording do you need on the certificate of insurance?

props.html: Forward this list to the events team, or send us the answers and we’ll plan around them.
Questions about music at Omni Interlocken

items.q: Can we bring our own band to a wedding at Omni Interlocken?
items.a: Hotels like Omni Interlocken generally let you book your own entertainment, within their rules on insurance, load-in and sound. Your event manager can confirm them for your date, and we send a certificate of insurance with every booking.

items.q: Does the band need Pinnacle Live, the resort’s AV company?
items.a: Our acts bring their own sound system. Pinnacle Live is the resort’s AV company for anything beyond what the act brings, and we’ll work out the details with the events team.

items.q: Can one act play the ceremony, the cocktail hour and the reception?
items.a: Yes. The same act can move with you from The ceremony lawn to The Outdoor Pavilion to The Interlocken Ballroom, and one booking covers all of it.

items.q: How much does live music add to a wedding at Omni Interlocken?
items.a: It depends on the size of the act and how much of the day it covers. Our pricing page has what live music costs in the Colorado market, and we’ll send a quote for your date.
